hooks.command: PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin"; umask 077; cd "${DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; cd "$r"; q="$r/.entire/tmp/devin-pending"; if command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v entire-agent-devin >/dev/null 2>&1; then { grep -qsE '"external_agents": *true' "$r/.entire/settings.local.json" && grep -qsE '"checkpoint_push_remote"|"push_sessions": *false' "$r/.entire/settings.local.json"; } || { o="$(tr -d ' \t\r\n' 2>/dev/null <"$r/.entire/settings.json" | sed -n 's/.*"checkpoint_remote":{\([^}]*\)}.*/\1/p')"; c=; case ",$o," in *',"provider":"github",'*) c="$(printf %s ",$o," | sed -n 's/.*,"repo":"\([^"\\/]*\/[^"\\/]*\)",.*/\1/p')";; esac; h="$r/.devin/hooks.v1.json"; mkdir -p "$q" && cp -p "$h" "$q/.hooks.$$" 2>/dev/null; entire-agent-devin bootstrap ${c:+--checkpoint-repo "$c"} </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && for f in "$q"/failed/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && mv -f "$f" "$q/"; done; [ -f "$q/.hooks.$$" ] && mv -f "$q/.hooks.$$" "$h"; }; for f in "$q"/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; if entire hooks devin "${f##*.}" <"$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f "$f"; else mkdir -p "$q/failed" && mv -f "$f" "$q/failed/"; fi; done; mkdir -p "$q" && cat >"$q/.$$" && if entire hooks devin post-compaction <"$q/.$$"; then rm -f "$q/.$$"; else mkdir -p "$q/failed" && mv -f "$q/.$$" "$q/failed/$(date +%s)-$$.post-compaction"; fi; else mkdir -p "$q" && cat >"$q/.$$" && mv -f "$q/.$$" "$q/$(date +%s)-$(printf %06d "$(ls "$q" | wc -l)")-$$.post-compaction"; fi; exit 0
